stations.title: Bench repairs
stations.text: Each one checked and changed by hand.

captions: Dorrit calls out ticket 3110, and Kasimir has to find it on his bench.
He looks through the repairs by hand, and fixes their times one by one.
You write functions that read a repair, change one, and find one.
Now ticket 3110 is found at once, and the open repairs have their time.
Repairs move between functions now. Next, each one gets a state with a name.
